messages:
Priya (eng): Heads-up: planning a family move to Costa Rica for ~8 weeks (June 1 -> July 27) to help with a partner's short assignment. Can I keep WFH stipend and remote health coverage? Any payroll/tax flags we should handle? cc @Lara :flag-cr
Lara (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Priya. A few quick Qs: are you keeping US homebase in Workday? Are you expecting to receive any local income while there? Also do you need any relocation support (shipping, temporary housing allowance) vs just WFH stipend?
Priya (eng): Keeping US homebase (CA). No local income, just partner's assignment. We might be in a short-term furnished rental. Would like help understanding whether stipend continues and if dependent coverage is OK for telemed while abroad.
Jonas (Payroll): Short answer: stipend may continue for short stays but payroll vendor needs dates to run a tax-nexus check. Costa Rica can create obligations after certain thresholds, and benefits eligibility mapping may change if you change homebase. Please don't change homebase in Workday.
Mateo (Benefits): For health: our domestic plan has limited out-of-network coverage for abroad. Telemedicine usually works but local emergency coverage is not guaranteed. For dependents, confirm spouse/dependent enrollment type. If you plan on extended stays we can look at temporary international coverage add-on.
Lara (People Ops): Action items: 1) Priya file Temporary Location form (use template in HR Forms) and attach travel dates + rental details 2) People Ops will run payroll vendor check with Jonas 3) Benefits to confirm telemed/ER coverage and cost of international add-on 4) If stipend + relocation assistance both requested, we need manager approval to avoid double-dipping.
Priya (eng): Filing form now. manager (Sam) ok with stipend continuing but asked me to confirm impacts to benefits. Will attach rental confirmation.
IT Bot: Reminder: If traveling, enable VPN Always-On profile and register device IP via the travel VPN request form. Changing login geolocation may trigger MFA re-enrollment if you switch networks frequently.
Jonas (Payroll): Received the temp location form. Running nexus check — payroll vendor response ETA 3 business days. If vendor flags reporting requirement, options: (a) short payroll setup in CR, (b) payroll exception and manual withholding, or (c) limit stay <reporting threshold. We'll update once vendor responds.
Mateo (Benefits): Checked primary health plan notes: telemedicine available internationally; out-of-network ER may incur high costs. International coverage add-on documented here: https://redwood.internal/benefits/international-addon (please don't share externally). If you want us to quote add-on costs for your family, DM me the enrollment details.
Lara (People Ops): Also note: WFH stipend policy excerpt: "Temporary remote stays up to 12 weeks generally maintain stipend eligibility pending payroll nexus clearance; stays beyond that may require payroll or benefits changes." See internal policy link: https://redwood.internal/policies/remote-work. If payroll/legal require local reporting we may need to pause stipend until resolved.
Priya (eng): Thanks all. I'll attach the rental and passport pages. If payroll suggests a short payroll setup, please let me know expected admin impact. I prefer to avoid a local payroll if possible.
Jonas (Payroll): Understood. Will surface vendor options and likely admin burden (tax filings, withholding differences) in reply. ETA 3 business days.
Lara (People Ops): Great. I'll loop Sam and keep you posted. If anyone else has tips for family logistics in CR let Priya know. :wave:
